# Database schema

Generated 2026-09-28 from the SQLAlchemy models (`backend/app/models.py`): **15 tables**. SQLite by default (`SIH_DATABASE_URL`), PostgreSQL compatible (the same models, no SQLite-specific types).

**Design rule: no raw IQ arrays in the relational tables.** Samples are streamed to disk in `data/uploads`, and the analysis result (downsampled spectrum/waterfall, symbol decisions, previews) is written to a compressed cache file next to the analysis record. The database stores queryable *metadata* only - parameters, hypotheses, confidences, evidence, bit statistics - so history, comparison and reporting are pure SQL.

## Where the big arrays live

| Data | Location |
| --- | --- |
| raw samples | `data/uploads/<uuid>.<ext>` (streamed, size-capped) |
| generated signals | `data/generated/<uuid>.<ext>` + ground truth JSON in the row |
| full analysis result | `data/cache/<analysis_id>.json.gz` (charts, symbols, previews) |
| reports | `data/reports/<uuid>.pdf\|json\|csv\|txt` |
